meta.name: Bug Fix
meta.description: Use when something in dazl-pr-panel-sandbox is broken. Clarifies the bug or bugs with the run owner, then runs unattended: explores the code for likely causes, reproduces each bug with evidence, runs Implement Code Fix (fix, then Review and Fix), validates the fix as QA, waits for a human review, and babysits the pull request until CI is green and no review comment is open.

nodes.title: Start
nodes.description: Describe what is broken: what you did, what you expected and what happened. Several bugs are fine.

nodes.title: Clarify
nodes.description: Interactive: asks the run owner questions until each bug has steps to reproduce, an expected and an actual result. Writes specs/bugs/<bug-slug>/bug.md.
nodes.prompt: This step is interactive with the run owner. Read the code the report points at, draft specs/bugs/<bug-slug>/bug.md, then ask the owner one question at a time until every in-scope bug has concrete steps to reproduce, an expected result and an actual result. Finish when the owner confirms the report.

nodes.title: Investigate
nodes.description: Explores the code for the likely causes of each bug and ranks them with path:line evidence. Writes investigation.md. No code changes.
nodes.prompt: This step is automatic: never ask a question. Explore dazl-pr-panel-sandbox for the likely causes of every bug in specs/bugs/<bug-slug>/bug.md and write investigation.md with ranked hypotheses and reproduction hints.

nodes.title: Reproduce
nodes.description: Reproduces each bug on the unfixed code: a failing regression test where possible, plus screenshots, videos or API output as "before" evidence. Writes reproduction.md.
nodes.prompt: This step is automatic: never ask a question. Reproduce every bug in specs/bugs/<bug-slug>/bug.md on the current code, guided by investigation.md. Prefer a failing regression test; add runtime captures when the bug shows in the UI or the API. Do not fix anything.

nodes.title: Implement code fix
nodes.description: Runs Implement Code Fix: the Bug Fix Implementer fixes the root cause, then Review and Fix reviews and fixes the change.
nodes.instruction: The bug folder is the newest one under specs/bugs/; it holds bug.md, investigation.md and reproduction.md from this Bug Fix run, and the reproduce step's regression tests are already on the run branch.

nodes.title: Validate the fix
nodes.description: QA: re-runs every reproduction on the fixed code, captures "after" evidence paired with the before captures, and checks for regressions. Writes validation.md. No code changes.
nodes.prompt: This step is automatic: never ask a question. Validate the fix on the run branch against specs/bugs/<bug-slug>/bug.md and reproduction.md: re-run each reproduction, capture after evidence with the same screen names as the Reproduce step, and run the regression checks.

nodes.title: Human review
nodes.description: A person reviews the fix with the before and after evidence. Approve to open the pull request; reject to send the fix, the reproduction or the bug report back with a comment.

nodes.title: Babysit until green
nodes.description: Squashes each changed repository's run branch onto its latest base, checks it, and opens a draft pull request for dazl-pr-panel-sandbox against main. Then fixes failing checks and answers review comments until CI is green and no review thread is open.
nodes.prompt: This step is automatic: never ask a question. The human review approved this fix. Document folder: specs/bugs/<bug-slug>/ (the slug from the Clarify step). Branch prefix: fix. Pull request body: the bug (steps, expected, actual) from bug.md, the root cause from investigation.md, the fix, and the before and after evidence and regression checks from reproduction.md and validation.md. Workspace-root pull request: no; open a pull request only for dazl-pr-panel-sandbox/, against main. Then keep fixing failing checks and unresolved review comments until every required check is green and no review thread is open, within your round limit, following your instructions.
